facts.text: The 19th-century manor sits high on a hill overlooking vine-covered terraces, with the Douro river at its feet.
facts.excerpt: This 19th-century manor sits high on a hill overlooking vine-covered terraces with the Douro river gently flowing at its feet.

facts.text: The manor has been restored with contemporary interiors reflecting the region's heritage.
facts.excerpt: It has been beautifully restored, with contemporary interiors reflecting both the region's rich heritage and our Six Senses design values.

facts.text: Rooms, suites and villas are set within kitchen gardens and vineyards.
facts.excerpt: Spacious and comfortable rooms, suites and villas set within flourishing kitchen gardens and vineyards

facts.text: The address is Quinta de Vale Abraao, Samodaes.
The resort's Forest Restoration Project nurses its parkland back to health as a home for soil fertility, fungi, insects and birds.
facts.excerpt: We take great pride and pleasure in nursing this parkland back to health and making it a home for soil fertility, fungi, insects and birds.

facts.text: Douro Valley vintages can be tasted with guidance from the resort's sommelier.
facts.excerpt: Taste the best Douro Valley vintages, expertly guided by the resort's sommelier

facts.text: Dining uses homegrown vegetables and herbs and fresh produce from the valley.
facts.excerpt: Homegrown vegetables and herbs along with fresh produce harvested from the verdant valley

facts.text: The spa offers locally inspired therapies, a heated pool, gym and yoga pavilion.
facts.excerpt: 10 treatment rooms administering locally inspired therapies, a heated pool, gym and yoga pavilion

facts.text: Rooms have vineyard views from huge windows.
facts.excerpt: Generously sized rooms with vineyard views from huge windows

facts.text: Contemporary decor blends with natural materials and Portuguese design.
facts.excerpt: Contemporary décor blends with natural materials and authentic Portuguese design.

facts.text: Activities include a gourmet river cruise and visits to historic wineries.
facts.excerpt: Join in a variety of activities and adventures from our hotel in Douro Valley including, a gourmet river cruise and invitations to hidden jewels and historic wineries.

facts.text: Guests can be winemaker for a day and go grape stomping in season.
facts.excerpt: Be winemaker for a day and even go grape stomping in season.
